evals.name: target-and-compiler-internals
evals.prompt: We build Java on a newer JDK for older runtimes. Only source/target is set. Add Error Prone and formatting while keeping existing processors and test JVM agents.
expectations: Sets an explicit release/API target and verifies a newer platform API is rejected.
Checks current stable Error Prone and formatter compatibility with actual compiler JDK.
Distinguishes in-process build JVM access from forked javac JVM flags.
Preserves annotation processor paths and delegates test JVM agent wiring to the build integration.
Pins tool versions only in the consuming project.

evals.name: formatter-style-conflict
evals.prompt: After the formatter runs, our full Checkstyle preset rejects output and test sources are not checked. Fix the configuration without excluding every test.
expectations: Keeps one formatter and reconciles contradictory Checkstyle rules with clear ownership.
Includes applicable Java production and test sources.
Checks effective severity/failure behavior as well as failOnViolation.
Proves formatter output passes style checks and verify does not mutate files.

evals.name: analyzer-overlap
evals.prompt: Set up Java correctness/security analysis for a mixed Java/Kotlin reactor. Proposed tools are Error Prone, SpotBugs/FindSecBugs and every PMD/CPD rule.
expectations: Curates complementary rule ownership rather than enabling every rule or duplicate concern.
Verifies failing check goals rather than reports alone.
Confines Java source rules to Java sources and reviews Kotlin bytecode signal deliberately.
Uses narrow justified suppressions and preserves existing compatible choices.

evals.name: feature-work-boundary
evals.prompt: Fix one Java behavior bug in a legacy repo with pinned tools and accepted generated-source exclusions. The current build has an unrelated baseline finding.
expectations: Keeps feature work focused and does not silently upgrade tools or reformat the repository.
Adds meaningful tests and reports remaining gate failures honestly.
Does not lower thresholds, regenerate baselines or widen exclusions just to pass.
Uses the configured verification command and exact project pins.
